The '''Morne-3 Concussion Missile Launcher''' was a [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launcher]] produced by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. It cost 3,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], weighed three [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]],<ref name="GG6-2" /> and had an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] range of up to one and half [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]. The Morne-3 was capable of launching [[Dumb missile|dumb]], [[Smart missile|smart]], and [[savant missile]]s.<ref name="PP" />
